items.docs: Get a paginated list of employees with optional filtering by email, Leapsome ID, displayed name, or status. Returns basic employee information including teams, departments, and custom attributes.

params.name: userId
params.description: Employee ID whose secondary access roles are being updated

items.docs:
Update the secondary access roles and user-specific access scope for one employee.
Primary access roles cannot be updated through this endpoint.

For roles with `userScopeType` set to `userSpecific`, provide a matching
`accessRoleCustomConfigurations` entry. The public API only supports `include.users`
in user-specific access scope configurations.

Requires the standard Super Admin access role; for API tokens, assign that role to the API key.

params.name: filter
params.description: The filter parameter must be a properly formed SCIM filter using the operator "eq" (equals). We support a "userName" filter only.

params.name: count
params.description: The amount of elements you would like to get returned.

params.name: startIndex
params.description: The offset (starts from 1, not 0) used to lookup elements. If you need to paginate, your next startIndex value would be "startIndex + count".

Creates a new organization user and adds them to the user domain. The user email domain must match an existing organization email domain.

Note: All user need to get created before you start assigning managers or groups using the other PATCH and PUT endpoints.
